warnings: RECTANGULAR_AOI_BOUNDARY: Jalandhar boundary is a rectangular Area of Interest (AOI), not an official Municipal Corporation Jalandhar (MCJ) administrative boundary shapefile.
CROSS_CITY_SCORE_NON_EQUIVALENCE: Scores in jalandhar cannot be compared directly to Amritsar flood probabilities.
evidenceLimitations: SECONDARY_JOURNALISTIC_SOURCES_ONLY: Incident inventory is derived from newspaper reports (source_reported) without independent sub-daily rain gauge telemetry or official municipal complaint registers. In strict adherence to the governing directive, Jalandhar remains evidence_insufficient until official municipal logs are integrated.

gridAudit.crsEvaluation: EPSG:32643 is appropriate for study area (75.52°E to 75.66°E, central meridian 75.0°E, scale distortion < 0.05%).

dataOrigin.provenanceNote: Derived from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 30m raster, ESA WorldCover 2021 10m raster, and OpenStreetMap vector layers with road network topology.

beforeAndAfterP24VsP25.auditVerdict: P25 successfully eliminated the 93.2% mid-band compression and restored natural spatial contrast (std improved from 0.0828 to 0.1505). Low-point representation dropped from 64.7% to 12.4%, matching physical hydrological reality.

crossCityComparability.crossCityScoreEquivalence: NON-EQUIVALENT: Susceptibility score S=0.50 in jalandhar DOES NOT equal S=0.50 in Amritsar. Feature weights (depression=0.3, builtUp=0.3) and cutoffs (0.33, 0.66) were transferred from Amritsar without localized empirical calibration. Scores are ordinal within jalandhar only.
